openrouter.title: MeterSnap - Configure OpenRouter

OpenRouter provides access to many Vision models (including free models).

openrouter_model.title: MeterSnap - Select OpenRouter Model
openrouter_model.description:
Select your desired Vision model. Free models are marked with ✨ and listed at the top.

If your model is not listed, choose 'Enter custom model manually...' and type its ID below.

custom.title: MeterSnap - Local AI / Custom Endpoint
custom.description: Connect a local OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. local Ollama with LLaVA or Qwen2-VL). For local instances without authentication, leave the API key empty.

gemini.title: MeterSnap - Configure Google Gemini
gemini.description: Connects Google Gemini Vision API. An API key can be generated at Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

error.empty_api_key: Please enter a valid API key.

openai.title: MeterSnap - Configure OpenAI
openai.description: Connects official OpenAI Vision API (e.g. GPT-4o-mini). An API key from OpenAI Dashboard (platform.openai.com) is required.

error.empty_api_key: Please enter a valid API key.

gas.title: MeterSnap - Gas Tariff
gas.description: Configure your gas contract values (from your gas bill).

dashboard.title: MeterSnap energy dashboard
dashboard.description: Optionally add “MeterSnap Energie” to the sidebar: photo upload and manual readings alongside Home Assistant energy charts. Uses your existing energy sources; configure them under Settings → Dashboards → Energy. You can edit the cards in the dashboard. Disabling this option hides the page and preserves its layout. Manage this page here in MeterSnap, not in the list of manually created dashboards.
